scope: Single-tab return to Studionet after checked-consent network invalidation. Verifies restored UI eligibility, no revived confirmation and fresh unchecked consent. No wallet request or transaction.

inputs.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
inputs.draft: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.
inputs.consent_label: I checked the content and agree to publish it.

sequence_notes: The human was asked to return ReplyCheck's site network to Studionet while retaining B, without a transaction or signature. The first fresh application snapshot showed B/owner and restored approval, with no confirmation. The agent did not cancel or reload during that transition.
The agent inspected the empty draft, entered the known public fixture to observe restored eligibility without clicking Review draft, then cleared only those temporary inputs.
The agent explicitly opened a fresh answer-card confirmation and observed unchecked consent and disabled Continue to wallet. Consent was not toggled and Continue to wallet was not activated.

The agent cancelled only that fresh local confirmation. The first post-cancel observation preserved a temporary title-empty closing shell. After waiting for the generic dialog role to detach, the settled closing snapshot had no dialog or waiting/recovery state.
Observation times are browser-check wall-clock timestamps. The existing displayed review time 2026-09-12 15:03:29 UTC is not a new transaction or network-change timestamp.

checks.claim: The first post-return UI recognizes B as owner on the ready network, restores answer-card approval, and does not revive the discarded confirmation.
The exact valid public fixture is eligible again, while the originally empty draft remains blocked only by input validation.
A fresh confirmation starts with unchecked consent and disabled Continue to wallet; prior checked consent is not reused.
Temporary drafts and the fresh test confirmation are cleared; the same ten history entries and matching review remain with no staged operation after the closing animation.

output_payload.reason_code_scope: No contract execution; UI restoration/reset only.

limitations: Human MetaMask interaction was not continuously recorded. Network readiness and the expected wallet are verified through the displayed application UI, not a new provider/RPC trace.
Local source pins and preceding saved evidence remain unchanged; no fresh deployed-source comparison, full-state RPC, chain output or reason code is claimed.

The checked-consent account/network unsigned-confirmation round trip is complete in this one Chrome tab. Pending-transaction identity/network recovery, actual concurrent sends, broader adversarial/native accessibility and public release gates remain open.
